articles.title: High Drama in Aligarh: Woman Clashes with BJP Leader Gaurang Tiwari Inside Police Station
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Aligarh witnessed high-voltage drama on Sunday as a long-standing dispute between BJP youth leader Gaurang Tiwari and a local woman erupted into a chaotic scene inside the Delhi Gate police station.

body.html:
Aligarh witnessed high-voltage drama on Sunday as a long-standing dispute between BJP youth leader Gaurang Tiwari and a local woman erupted into a chaotic scene inside the Delhi Gate police station.

The Incident: The conflict began as a public scuffle in the Ghudiabagh locality on January 11, 2026. Following the altercation, police intervened and brought both parties to the station, where the situation escalated.

Viral Footage: Videos circulating on social media show the woman and her mother expressing outrage after the BJP leader was allegedly seated in the SHO's room. The footage captures the mother waving a slipper and the woman accusing the leader of misuse of power, shouting, "I am a victim, not a politician."

Official Response: SHO Ishwar Singh stated that both parties have leveled allegations against each other and have been sent for medical examinations. Police clarified that the matter stems from an old domestic dispute and investigation is underway.

articles.title: CCTV: Thief Steals from Temple, Then Folds Hands to Apologize | Bizarre Incident in Jhansi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre and ironic incident has come to light in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, where a thief sought forgiveness from the deity immediately after robbing a temple. The entire act was captured on CCTV and is now viral.

body.html:
A bizarre and ironic incident has come to light in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, where a thief sought forgiveness from the deity immediately after robbing a temple. The entire act was captured on CCTV and is now viral.

The Incident: On Saturday night, a thief broke into the Badi Mata Temple on Garautha–Madhan Road. Taking advantage of the darkness, he stole precious jewelry from the idols.

The Shocking Moment: CCTV footage shows the accused, wearing a blue hoodie and cap, stealing the valuables. However, just before leaving, he is seen folding his hands and bowing before the deity, appearing to apologize for his crime.

Current Status: The theft was discovered Sunday morning by devotees. The Garautha Police are investigating the footage to identify the suspect, though no formal written complaint has been filed yet.

articles.title: Wife Seeks Divorce from Priest Husband After Becoming Police SI | "Embarrassed by His Profession"
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of marital discord has reached the Bhopal Family Court, sparking a debate on social values and gratitude. The Background: A husband, who works as a priest, spent his hard-earned savings from religious rituals to fund his wife’s education and training.

body.html:
A shocking case of marital discord has reached the Bhopal Family Court, sparking a debate on social values and gratitude.

The Background: A husband, who works as a priest, spent his hard-earned savings from religious rituals to fund his wife’s education and training. His support helped her fulfill her dream of becoming a Police Sub-Inspector (SI).

The Conflict: According to the husband, after his wife joined the force, her behavior changed drastically. She allegedly expressed embarrassment over his traditional appearance—wearing a dhoti-kurta and maintaining a traditional braid (tuft of hair).

The Divorce: Claiming "social embarrassment" due to her husband's profession and lifestyle, the woman has filed for divorce. Despite multiple attempts at reconciliation by court counselors, she remains firm in her decision to end the marriage.

The case is currently under consideration in the Bhopal Family Court.

articles.title: Deoria Mazar Demolition: 50-Year-Old Shrine Removed by Administration | Court Order
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Deoria district administration carried out a major demolition drive on Sunday, removing the 50-year-old Hazrat Shaheed Syed Abdul Gani Shah Baba Mazar located near the Gorakhpur Road overbridge.

body.html:
The Deoria district administration carried out a major demolition drive on Sunday, removing the 50-year-old Hazrat Shaheed Syed Abdul Gani Shah Baba Mazar located near the Gorakhpur Road overbridge.

The Order: The action followed an order from the Sadar SDM Court, which declared the land as "barren government property." The court noted that the defence failed to produce documents establishing when the shrine was constructed during the hearings.

Key Details:

Complaint: The case reportedly originated from a complaint filed in 2019 by BJP MLA Dr. Shalabh Mani Tripathi.

The Operation: Three bulldozers were deployed for a six-hour operation to demolish the main gate, boundary wall, shops, and the dome.

Security: To maintain law and order, around 300 police personnel were deployed under the supervision of SDM Shruti Sharma.

Official Stance: Municipal authorities stated the structure was illegally built on government-owned agricultural/barren land. The administration emphasized that the demolition was in strict compliance with the court's directive.

articles.title: Kanpur Man Brutally Murdered in Gurugram | Wife Arrested | SP Leader's Brother Found Dead
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking and brutal murder has come to light in Gurugram, where the mutilated body of a Kanpur resident, Faisal Idrisi (30), was discovered in Sector 37.

body.html:
A shocking and brutal murder has come to light in Gurugram, where the mutilated body of a Kanpur resident, Faisal Idrisi (30), was discovered in Sector 37.

The Horrific Discovery: Faisal’s body was found in a decomposed state, hidden under stones in a vacant plot behind the Bharat Petrol Pump near Shani Mandir. The post-mortem confirmed he was brutally murdered—his throat was slit, veins were cut, and his hands and legs were tied.

The Accused: Haryana Police have arrested Faisal’s wife, Uzma. The victim's brother, Shadab Alam (Metropolitan President, SP Youth Brigade, Kanpur), has accused Uzma, her maternal uncle Aftab, and her family of the conspiracy.

The Motive: The couple had a strained relationship, with frequent disputes after Uzma allegedly pressured Faisal to move from Kanpur to Gurugram. The family claims Faisal suspected his wife’s character and had reported being assaulted just days before he went missing in late December.

Status: A murder case has been registered at Sector 10A Police Station. While Uzma is in custody, a manhunt is underway for her uncle Aftab and other accomplices.

articles.title: Indore: Woman Beats Supervisor with Slippers Over Harassment & Conversion Pressure
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A high-voltage drama erupted in Indore’s Lasudia area on Thursday (08 Jan 2025) when a call center employee confronted and beat her supervisor on the street for alleged harassment and pressure to convert to Islam.

body.html:
A high-voltage drama erupted in Indore’s Lasudia area on Thursday (08 Jan 2025) when a call center employee confronted and beat her supervisor on the street for alleged harassment and pressure to convert to Islam.

The Incident: A 33-year-old woman, who had worked at a call center for five years, alleged that her supervisor, Mohammad Abdul Salam, had been harassing her since November 2025. She claims he pressured her for friendship and even threatened her to convert to Islam, promising a "better future."

Forced to Quit: Fed up with the harassment, the victim resigned in December 2025. However, the accused allegedly continued to stalk her even during her notice period. On Thursday, when he grabbed her hand in public, she took matters into her own hands.

Bajrang Dal Involvement: The victim approached Bajrang Dal workers, who located the accused. In a fit of rage, the woman beat him with slippers in public. Police have arrested the accused and reportedly found objectionable chats on his phone.

Now known as Anshika, she shared her journey of love and faith. The Love Story: The couple first met four years ago at a local fair in the Bhojipura area.

body.html:
In Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, a 20-year-old woman named Aashiya has made headlines by embracing Sanatan Dharma to marry her lover, Monu. Now known as Anshika, she shared her journey of love and faith.

The Love Story: The couple first met four years ago at a local fair in the Bhojipura area. Anshika describes it as "love at first sight." Over the years, their bond grew, leading them to decide on marriage.

Why She Chose Sanatan Dharma: Anshika explained that she had been following Hindu traditions for years and felt a deep connection to Sanatan customs. She expressed her dislike for practices like triple talaq, halala, and the hijab, stating she wanted a life of independence and freedom.

The Ceremony: The marriage was solemnized at the August Muni Ashram by Pandit KK Shankhdhar after all legal formalities and purification rituals were completed. The priest confirmed that the marriage took place voluntarily and without any external pressure.

articles.title: Love Triangle Leads to Murder: Wife & Lover Kill Husband in Sambhal | UP Police Investigation
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Sambhal Police have solved the brutal murder of 22-year-old Sunny from Hathras, revealing a chilling conspiracy involving his wife, her lover, and her brother. The Discovery: On January 2nd, an unidentified body was found near the Dubhari Khurd-Puran Patti road.

body.html:
The Sambhal Police have solved the brutal murder of 22-year-old Sunny from Hathras, revealing a chilling conspiracy involving his wife, her lover, and her brother.

The Discovery: On January 2nd, an unidentified body was found near the Dubhari Khurd-Puran Patti road. Post-mortem reports confirmed that the victim had been strangled to death. The victim was later identified by his wife, Neha, as her husband Sunny.

The Conspiracy: Investigation by the team under ASP Anukriti Sharma revealed that Neha had been in a relationship with a man named Ranjeet for four years. Claiming she was harassed by Sunny, Neha plotted with Ranjeet and her brother Arun to eliminate him.

The Execution: On January 1st, Sunny was lured to a location in the Junawai area, where the accused made him consume alcohol before beating him and finally strangling him with a rope.

All three accused—Neha, Ranjeet, and Arun—have been arrested and sent to jail. Watch the full report for more details on the police investigation.

articles.title: "Absolutely Insane!" | Former YouTuber Nalini Unagar Slams Zomato Over 100% Price Hike
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The debate over food delivery pricing has reignited after former YouTuber Nalini Unagar (of Nalini's Kitchen Recipe) shared a shocking price discrepancy on Zomato.

body.html:
The debate over food delivery pricing has reignited after former YouTuber Nalini Unagar (of Nalini's Kitchen Recipe) shared a shocking price discrepancy on Zomato.

The Controversy: Nalini shared a photo showing her restaurant bill for Veg Manchurian and Chinese Bhel totaling ₹320, while the same order on Zomato was listed at ₹655. Even with discounts, she was asked to pay ₹550—nearly double the original price.

Zomato’s Defense: The platform responded by stating that prices are "solely determined by restaurant partners" and that Zomato acts only as an intermediary.

The Backlash: Social media users aren't buying it. Many are questioning the "hidden" 25-35% commissions and ad fees that force restaurants to inflate their menu prices just to break even. This video dives into the breakdown of online food costs and whether the "convenience fee" has gone too far.
